tenderSchedule.description: Health Insurance Coverage for HDCC Bank 196 Employees and 701 dependents.
tenderSchedule.deptName: The Hassan District Co Operative Central Bank Ltd Hassan
tenderSchedule.locationName: The Hassan District Co Operative Central Bank Ltd

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder should quote the premium amount for Group Health Insurance Coverage for Hassan DCC Bank Employees and their Dependents for 196 Employees And 701 Dependents for one year and the sum insured per family is Rs. 5,00,000-00 (Rs. Five Lakh only) and buffering of Rs. 20,00,000-00 (Rs. Twenty lakh only)
The Bidder should follow the terms and conditions of the Bank.
The Bank has the right to accept, reject or cancel the tender.
Family Floater-Employee, Spouse, Dependents, Children and Parents.
Cover for pre existing diseases from day one, Internal and External shall be covered.
Maternity extension normal - Rs. 30,000-00 and Maternity extension Caesarean Rs. 50,000-00.
Waiver of 9 months waiting period for maternity (From day one cover)
Emergency Ambulance charges up to sum of Rs. 1,000-00 per hospitalization and overall limit of Rs. 2,000-00 per policy period.
Sub limits only for Cataract Rs. 1,00,000-00 per person per policy period.
TPA and Broker Companies are not allowed.
Cashless treatment in PAN India and all day care procedures covered.
Bidder Health Insurance Company shall have Branch at Hassan, Karnataka.
Pre Hospitalization 30 days and post hospitalization 60 days applicable.
Corporate Buffer of Rs. 20,00,000-00 (Rs. Twenty Lakh only) to be extended after Rs. 5,00,000-00 sum assured completed, Rs. 5,00,000-00 per family.
All Advanced modern treatments shall be covered up to sum assured Rs. 5.00 lakh.
Room Rent coverage up to AC Room and ICU Room Rent shall be actual.
Ayurveda treatment capping shall be up to 50,000-00
All other terms and conditions as per GHI policy clause.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: IRDA certified licensed copy shall be attached.
